item.title: Watch: Boxer gets hairpiece knocked off mid-match
item.description: Jarrell Miller was in the second round of a heavyweight bout against Kingsley Ibeh in the iconic Madison Square Garden, when a sharp right hand saw his hairpiece lift up.

item.title: Person dies after two-vehicle crash near Matamata
item.description: One person has died following a serious crash on Puketutu Rd near Matamata on Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Fuel from capsized Akaroa boat leaks into the ocean, creating sheen
item.description: The fuel from a capsized tourist boat in Akaroa has leaked into the ocean, creating a fuel sheen around the vessel.

item.title: Undercover investigation of Meta heads to trial in New Mexico in first stand-alone case by state
item.description: New Mexico's case is built on a state undercover investigation using proxy social media accounts and posing as kids to document sexual solicitations and the response from Meta, the owner of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.

item.title: Dan Hooker suffers brutal second-round TKO defeat at UFC 325
item.description: Benoit Saint Denis, who hasn’t seen a third round since his UFC debut in 2021, began a ground and pound with several brutal elbows before finishing with a bevy of punches.

item.title: Breakers’ season on the brink after late heartbreak in Hobart
item.description: Post-season basketball now looks a bridge too far for the undermanned New Zealand Breakers after they were unable to find lightning in a bottle for the second time in three days in Hobart on Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Phoenix score four goals during one-sided first half
item.description: Follow live updates as the Phoenix search for a third away victory against the Newcastle Jets.

item.title: Mayor praises community, recovery operations completed at Mount Maunganui landslide site
item.description: All recovery operations at Mount Maunganui have been completed and stood down, and Disaster Victim Identification (DVI) and Search and Rescue teams will leave the scene, police announced on Sunday.

item.title: Black Ferns Sevens storm into Singapore final after emphatic win against the US
item.description: The powerful winger crossed for three of New Zealand’s eight tries in the semifinal.

item.title: Iran says it now considers EU militaries to be terrorist groups
item.description: The speaker of Iran's parliament said that the Islamic Republic now considers all European Union militaries to be terrorist groups.
